method.configuration: source-phrase module worker, public source snapshots, unchanged limits
method.scope: Fresh serial headless Chrome browser/page/module-worker per size/repetition. Actual native postMessage plus first event.data access bracketed with primitive performance marks; only primitive envelope metadata retained.
method.instrumentation: First data access moves into observer wrapper before actual adapter listener. Native arguments/events and ordering remain; observer marks/logs/trace can perturb elapsed time. No performance.mark detail, fake transport or production source patch.
method.work: Complete named native factory elapsed intervals inside exact send/read brackets, correlated to adapter IDs and distinct main/worker targets/isolates/threads. Neither CPU time nor total adapter capture/validation/FIFO/codec cost.
method.memory: Detailed global MemoryInfra point dump commands, full raw allocator attrs and serialization-named paths. Hierarchical/overlapping type/allocator quantities are not summed, assigned per message, converted to physical copies or called allocation peaks. Raw command dump GUIDs and exported event IDs remain separate.
method.archive: Tracing ReturnAsStream original JSON bytes via bounded IO.read, gzip archived with raw/compressed hashes. Only fields used for correlation must be safe numbers; native flow IDs are unused. 64MiB raw cap, no trace loss,60s CDP/180s operation timeouts.
method.limits: Public deadlines remain60s and response timeout120s. Typed resource/deadline restore refusals must preserve prior exact state; instrumentation does not increase native ceilings. No AT/browser-native/physical/portability/publication claim.
